Respond to Andy Cutright in Google Chat in the existing Chrome tab. Do this as Tyson Goulding. Do not use any API/connector.

Setup:
- Chrome is already open on the box. There is a Google Chat tab currently titled "Justin Lee - Chat" (chat.google.com). Switch to THAT tab. Do not use Slack.
- Signed in as Tyson Goulding (tyson.goulding@optconnect.com).
- Find the 1:1 DM with Andy Cutright (not a space). Open it.

Read first:
- Read the latest messages in that DM, especially Andy's most recent message(s) that still need a reply from Tyson.
- Copy the last ~8 messages verbatim (who said what, roughly when).

Then reply:
- Send ONE short reply in Tyson's Google Chat voice: short, casual, one thought, mostly lowercase, missing apostrophes ok (Ill, its), ty/yay/Will do!/nvm as they fit. No corporate tone. No emoji unless he would.
- The reply must actually answer Andy's latest ask. Do not invent facts, IPs, status, or commitments Tyson hasn't already stated in the thread. If Andy asked something you cannot answer from the thread, send a short holding reply he would actually send (e.g. "Ill take a look" or "quick call?") rather than making something up.
- If the latest from Andy is already fully answered by Tyson, do NOT send another message. Report that instead.
- Type in the Chat compose box and send. Do not message anyone else. Do not send in Slack.

Report back:
- Last messages in the Andy DM (verbatim)
- Whether you sent, and the exact text sent
- Screenshot path if you took one
